1170-1329-1492-8201.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-8201.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

602-4691-8242.description:
Activate Songbird by discarding a card.
Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Songbird ability, giving Songbird flying until end of turn
Repeat

3469-4644-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3469-4644-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4474-5075--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-5075--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

997-2178-7690-7797--165.description:
Activate Agent Phil Coulson by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Hero you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Wall.
When the Wall dies, Agent Phil Coulson triggers, untapping Agent Phil Coulson.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

423-765-872-1437--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-765-872-1437--85.description:
Cast Scaled Herbalist by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Scaled Herbalist spell three times.
Resolve the first Scaled Herbalist copy.
Activate the Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-4771-5220-7286.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1322-2769-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Highspire Artisan.
When Highspire Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Highspire Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Urza's Bauble.
Cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Bounding Krasis.
When Bounding Krasis enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

277-880-6662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-6662.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack and Tiller Engine trigger, creating a creature token and untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

774-4826-5621.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

326-4212.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Silverquill Apprentice triggers, giving a creature you control +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve Chain of Smog, causing you to discard two cards and copy Chain of Smog, targeting yourself.
Repeat from step 2.

2035-2523-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gollum, adding one mana of any color.
When Gollum dies, it and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a  nonlegendary token copy of Gollum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Gollum trigger from step 2, causing the Ring to tempt you, and for the Gollum token to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Repeat.

265-2034-4559-5272.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have a combined mana value of ten or greater.
265-2034-4559-5272.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, adding {C}{C}.
When Metlwork Colossus dies, Sly Requisitioner and Farid trigger.
Resolve the Sly Requisitioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Farid trigger, creating a Scrap artifact token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Servo and the Scrap token, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying at most {1}.
Repeat.

1651-2097-4330.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has fought this turn.
1651-2097-4330.description:
Activate Boxing Ring by tapping it, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Boxing Ring.
Repeat.

1379-2493-3210-4050.notablePrerequisites: At least four additional creatures in graveyard and/or on the battlefield.
1379-2493-3210-4050.description:
Cast Scrap Mastery by paying {3}{R}{R}, swapping all nonland permanents you control for all nonland permanents in your graveyard.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Scrap Mastery from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing Archaeomancer and four other creatures, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1661-4474-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

779-833-2546-4772.description:
Activate Soul of Windgrace's second ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

Woodfall Primus dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Woodfall Primus enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Remnant of the Rising Star.
Resolve the Woodfall Primus trigger, failing to destroy an indestructible noncreature permanent.
Resolve the Remnant of the Rising Star trigger, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Woodfall Primus.
Repeat.

2396-3017-4869.notablePrerequisites:
An additional card in hand.
The number of cards in library is greater than each opponent's life total.
Ophidian Eye attached to Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
2396-3017-4869.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve one trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, repeat.
Repeat.

1183-1308-2757.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pentavus, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Pentavite creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Pentavite, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate Pentavus' second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat from step 3.
